gate: PBA defect Gate 1 (Track L, session 66190d): 60-atom (4 f.u.) defect cells of relaxed KVCr / KVMo

settings.k_relax_scf: 2x2x2 MP shifted (1 1 1) on the 10.7-10.9 A cubic cell
settings.k_nscf: 4x4x4 Gamma-centred (folded Gamma, X, L, W of the fcc BZ)
settings.relax: ions only, fixed stage-1 cell, BFGS forc 1e-3 Ry/bohr, etot 1e-5*nat Ry, symmetry kept
settings.LCM_start: C-bound site +3, N-bound site -3 muB (site-based; antisites follow their site)
settings.projwfc: Lowdin, lsym false; raw files kept in jobs/<job>/raw/<id>/ (ANALYZE_ONLY=1 redoes the analysis)
settings.npool: largest divisor of the rank count <= min(NPOOL_MAX, 2 x irreducible k) (spglib, in the job)

jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 NB_EXTRA=40 RELAX_MAXSEC=14400 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 NPOOL_MAX=16 python pba_defect.py KVCr_AS.json
jobs.notes: antisite pair, cyanide orientation kept: M on the N-bound site (0 0 0), spin -; V on the C-bound site (1/2 1/2 1/2), spin +; the two antisites are not bonded (sqrt(3)/2 a); C3v about [111]
jobs.tests: V/M antisite pair (M on N-site, V on C-site), CN orientation kept: M_cell = 0 (isospin), antisite levels vs host edges and their spin, windows >= 50 %; E(AS) - E(P) (compare the full-isomer 0.44-0.81 eV/f.u.)

jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 NB_EXTRA=40 RELAX_MAXSEC=14400 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 NPOOL_MAX=16 python pba_defect.py KVCr_FLIP.json
jobs.notes: one CN flipped in place (+x CN of V(0 0 0)): V(0)-C and M(1/2 0 0)-N, positions kept (relax adjusts); C2v
jobs.tests: one CN flipped (V-C, M-N): M_cell = 0, flip-induced levels vs edges / spin, windows >= 50 %; E(FLIP) - E(P)

jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 NB_EXTRA=40 RELAX_MAXSEC=7200 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 NPOOL_MAX=8 python pba_defect.py KVCr_KVAC.json
jobs.notes: K vacancy at (1/4 1/4 1/4) (origin), one hole; Td about the vacancy (hole shared by the four equivalent V); M = +1 -> hole in the V-majority channel, -1 -> opposite channel
jobs.tests: K vacancy (one hole): where the hole goes (V t2g / CN / M) and its spin channel (M = +1 V-majority = host edge channel; M = -1 opposite); remaining windows; E_f(K-rich, mu_K = bcc K)

jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 NB_EXTRA=40 RELAX_MAXSEC=3600 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 NPOOL_MAX=8 python pba_defect.py KVCr_P.json
jobs.notes: pristine 4 f.u. (Td about V at the origin); host reference for all defects
jobs.tests: pristine 4 f.u. reference: M = 0, gap, edge spins, windows on the same 4x4x4 grid as the defects; deep-level reference for alignment; E for formation energies

jobs.cmd: ECUT=110 NB_EXTRA=40 RELAX_MAXSEC=18000 SCF_MAXSEC=7200 NPOOL_MAX=16 python pba_defect.py KVCr_VAC.json
